name: Frontpage Per Language
description: Lets a multilingual site define a different front page path for each language, resolved via path-processor and path-matcher decorators.
project_description:
The Front Page Per Language module allows to configure the front page per language.

 Features 
 You can set different front pages for each enabled language.

 Post-Installation 
 
 You should see text field for enabled language under Front Page section on Basic Site Settings page. 
 You should export the configurations after making changes. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This module is dependent on Drupal Core's language module.

 Maintainers
